Preconditions: Application is available; valid credential profile exists; product listing contains at least one product
Steps:
1. Open the login page using LOGIN_URL
2. Enter valid credentials using standardUser
3. Submit the login form
4. Add one product from the product listing
5. Inspect the added product button
Expected:
1. Login page is displayed
2. Username and password are entered
3. Home page is displayed
4. The product is added
5. The button displays Remove

Preconditions: Application is available; an invalid credential dataset exists
Steps:
1. Open the login page using LOGIN_URL
2. Enter invalid credentials from the invalid credential dataset
3. Submit the login form
4. Inspect navigation after rejection
Expected:
1. Login page is displayed
2. Username and password are entered
3. Error message is displayed: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service
4. Home page is not displayed

Description: Add only one unit of a product from the listing
Preconditions: User is logged in; product listing contains at least one product that has not been added
Steps:
1. Open the product listing
2. Add one displayed product
3. Inspect the same product button
4. Check whether the same product can be added again from the listing
Expected:
1. Product listing is displayed
2. The product is added
3. The button displays Remove
4. No add control is available for a second unit

Description: Remove one product from the listing
Preconditions: User is logged in; one product has been added and displays a Remove button
Steps:
1. Open the product listing
2. Select Remove for the added product
Expected:
1. The added product displays a Remove button
2. The product is removed from the added state
